rationale: The final five 1-minute candles printed steady lower highs, lower lows and lower closes (22.09 → 21.80) on expanding volume while price sits beneath both VWAP (21.97) and the 9-EMA (21.90). These conditions do not give the observed intraday supply enough runway to produce a repeatable edge before the forced exit.
